name: Context Trees
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Shows labels for local inline Markdown links in context trees.
Keeps search highlights and link navigation.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Inline Markdown links to your notes now show their label in the tree. Search highlights stay visible, and you can select a link to open its note.
Unlinked mentions with accented or non-Latin words now match correctly.
tip: Switch on the regular expression button to search each line with a pattern, with Pro.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Context Trees is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to find things in your vault.

related.name: Search Operators
related.blurb: Find notes by date and links, with a preview for each result.

related.name: Embedded Text Finder
related.blurb: Find notes through text in their Markdown embeds.

related.name: Bases Link Graph
related.blurb: Draws the notes that a base selects as an interactive graph. Links become edges, and you click a node to open its note.
